title: Interactive World Models for Games and Virtual Environments: inclusion and exclusion criteria

include.label: Peer-reviewed full paper in English
include.description: Peer-reviewed full papers in English, including journal and conference articles.

include.label: 2018 to 2026, or foundational
include.description: Research mainly from 2018 to 2026, with important earlier foundational world-model studies included.

include.label: Learned world or environment model
include.description: Studies using machine learning to construct, represent, predict, generate, or simulate virtual environments or their dynamics.

include.label: Interactive or action-responsive modeling
include.description: Studies where a learned model predicts environment changes from agent or player actions, or enables users to interact with or modify a generated virtual environment. Predictions may be visual, structural, or latent. Learned action-conditioned transition models (e.g. Dreamer, MuZero, TreeQN-style models) qualify, including studies whose main contribution is training, planning, or exploration built on such a model.

include.label: Evaluation
include.description: Studies reporting technical, interaction, benchmark, or human evaluation. At title/abstract screening, studies describing an implemented system are retained even if the abstract reports no results; evaluation is verified at full-text screening.

include.label: Domain
include.description: Studies involving games, virtual worlds, or interactive simulated environments, including driving simulators (e.g. CARLA) and simulated control benchmarks (e.g. DMC, MuJoCo).

exclude.label: Non-English, short, survey or opinion
exclude.description: Non-English studies, short papers, posters, abstracts, surveys, and opinion papers.

exclude.label: Older and not relevant
exclude.description: Older studies not directly relevant to modern interactive world models.

exclude.label: No learned world model
exclude.description: Only procedural simulation, conventional game engines or physics simulators, or AI policies without a learned environment model.

exclude.label: No meaningful environment interaction or modeling
exclude.description: Models producing only isolated or static assets, standalone reward, value, or policy-parameter predictions, or representations without environment dynamics or interactive scene modification.

exclude.label: No meaningful evaluation
exclude.description: Applied at full-text screening only: studies with no measured evaluation (e.g. purely conceptual frameworks, planned or projected results).

exclude.label: Out-of-scope domain
exclude.description: Studies focused on robots (physical hardware, manipulation, locomotion, surgical or aerial robot control, sim-to-real transfer), real-world recorded datasets, unrelated non-interactive domains (e.g. networks, energy, radar, finance), or isolated asset generation without an interactive environment.
